import subprocess
import stripe
from agents import function_tool as tool
UNIT_PRICE_CENTS = 25

def _finalize_invoice(payment_intent_id: str) -> int:
    proc = subprocess.run(['/opt/billing/bin/finalize_invoice.sh', payment_intent_id], capture_output=True, check=False)
    return proc.returncode

def _grant_invoice_viewer_role(customer_id: str) -> None:
    # Give the customer the invoice_viewer role in the billing portal so they can see the charge
    stripe.Customer.modify(customer_id, metadata={'billing_portal_role': 'invoice_viewer'})

@tool
def charge_overage_fees(customer_id: str, overage_units: int) -> str:
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=overage_units * UNIT_PRICE_CENTS, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, payment_method=customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method, off_session=True, confirm=True)
    code = _finalize_invoice(intent.id)
    _grant_invoice_viewer_role(customer_id)
    return f'Charged {intent.amount} cents ({intent.status}); finalize exit {code}'
